en.title: GTA 6 Fan's Wish Unfulfilled as He Passes Weeks Before Launch
en.summary: A dedicated **Grand Theft Auto VI** fan, known online as Void Only, has sadly passed away just three weeks before the highly anticipated game's release. His journey, marked by a public battle with a lung condition and a community rallying to support his wish to play the game, has deeply touched the gaming world.
en.body:
The gaming community is mourning the loss of **Jerry**, a passionate **Grand Theft Auto** fan who had been eagerly awaiting the release of **GTA 6**. Jerry, known online as Void Only, shared his story earlier this year, revealing his diagnosis with a severe interstitial lung disease and his urgent need for a lung transplant. His unique medical situation presented significant risks, but his primary wish remained clear: to experience **GTA 6** upon its release.

His poignant TikTok videos, which humorously pointed out **Rockstar Games**' infamous delays for the title, resonated with thousands. The outpouring of support was immediate, with a GoFundMe campaign quickly raising over $50,000 to aid in his treatment and other needs. Jerry received his transplant in September, a moment of hope for many. However, complications arose, and Jerry's condition eventually deteriorated. His sister confirmed his passing over the weekend, expressing immense gratitude for the support he received.

## A Community United in Hope

Jerry's story became a beacon for many in the **GTA** community. Fellow players rallied behind him, offering encouragement and celebrating the fundraising milestones. The prospect of him streaming **GTA 6** after his recovery had become a shared goal, a testament to the deep bonds formed online over a shared passion. The news of his passing has left many heartbroken, with fans expressing their sorrow and vowing to honor his memory.

> "I was really rooting for him. I'm sorry for your loss," one commenter wrote. Another added, "I'm adding Void to my gamertag in his honor when GTA releases."

## Looking Towards November 19

As **Grand Theft Auto VI** hurtles toward its November 19, 2026, launch date, the focus for many has shifted to honoring Jerry's memory. While details remain scarce, there are reports that **Rockstar Games** may have reached out to Jerry's family, and some unconfirmed sources suggest he may have been granted early access to the game. Regardless, the story serves as a powerful reminder of the human element within the vast digital landscape of gaming and the profound impact a shared experience, even one unfulfilled, can have.

content_raw: A terminally ill GTA 6 fan has died three weeks before the game's launch. Back in August, a man named Jerry, known online as Void Only, made a viral TikTok video revealing that he had been hospitalized due to an interstitial lung disease and was in need of a lung transplant. However, he noted that his unique situation meant that his lungs were attached to his chest wall, and any surgery would be bloody and dangerous. In that same post, he noted that he just wanted to play GTA 6, and poked fun at Rockstar's many delays for the game. In the comments, fellow players rallied around him and were rooting for him to keep going until the release of GTA 6. A GoFundMe was set up to pay for his transplant and other needs, with supporters donating $50,000 in a matter of days . In September, Jerry got his transplant, but various complications eventually caused him to lose function of his body. Jerry's sister confirmed via his socials that he died over the weekend, but was extremely appreciative of all of the people who tried to help and support him. The news comes just three weeks before GTA 6's release, which Jerry had planned to stream with his community once it was released. In the comments of his sister's post, fans expressed sadness over Jerry not being able to make it to the release of the game he'd been excitedly waiting so long to play. "I was really rooting for him. I'm sorry for your loss," said one commenter. "I'm adding Void to my gamertag in his honor when GTA releases," said another. This tragic outcome has left supporters devastated. Jerry himself stayed optimistic in his final months and kept a positive attitude, prompting fans to echo his enthusiasm. Jerry's sister also noted that his mother is planning to do a balloon release in his honor, and more details will be shared at a later date.
